<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Business identification details</strong>: Your website should clearly display the following business details: company name, business registration number, and contact information (address, email, phone number).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Industry alignment with website</strong>: The nature of your website must align with the industry specified in your application.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Website policies</strong>: Your website should include key policies such as Terms & Conditions, Shipping & Refund Policy, and Privacy Policy.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Checkout experience</strong>: Your website should support a checkout section with clear pricing and product details.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>No external redirection</strong>: Your website should not redirect users to external sites.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Governing law</strong>: The governing law in your website's terms of service must match your business's registered country. Learn <a href="https://help.airwallex.com/hc/en-gb/articles/14925284914703-Governing-Law" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="css-1ln76y2-link">more <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 32 32"><path d="M23.75 25.749V17C23.75 16.3096 24.3096 15.75 25 15.75C25.6904 15.75 26.25 16.3096 26.25 17V25.749C26.2497 27.1276 25.1324 28.25 23.75 28.25H6.25C4.86929 28.25 3.75 27.1307 3.75 25.75V8.25C3.75 6.86929 4.86929 5.75 6.25 5.75H14C14.6904 5.75 15.25 6.30964 15.25 7C15.25 7.69036 14.6904 8.25 14 8.25H6.25V25.75H23.749L23.75 25.749Z" fill="currentColor"></path><path d="M25.75 11V6.25H20C19.3096 6.25 18.75 5.69036 18.75 5C18.75 4.30964 19.3096 3.75 20 3.75H27C27.6904 3.75 28.25 4.30964 28.25 5V11C28.25 11.6904 27.6904 12.25 27 12.25C26.3096 12.25 25.75 11.6904 25.75 11Z" fill="currentColor"></path><path d="M25.1162 5.11621C25.6044 4.62806 26.3956 4.62806 26.8838 5.11621C27.3719 5.60437 27.3719 6.39563 26.8838 6.88379L15.8838 17.8838C15.3956 18.3719 14.6044 18.3719 14.1162 17.8838C13.6281 17.3956 13.6281 16.6044 14.1162 16.1162L25.1162 5.11621Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Language requirements</strong>: Applicable only to select payment methods.</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Japan (JP)</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>(1) Your website must have a fully localized Japanese version.</li>
<li>(2) Required information in Japanese (preferably present all the information on one page, titled 'NOTATION PAGE' or '特定商取引法に基づく表記'):
<ul>
<li>Company name and the name of the responsible sales representative/officer</li>
<li>Company office address</li>
<li>Contact information (phone & email), including operation hours</li>
<li>Payment method names (for example, Credit Card, Konbini, Pay-easy, PayPal)</li>
<li>Refund policy and shipment policy (including fees and delivery times)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>(3) Telephone Requirements: A phone number operated by Japanese speakers must be publicly available. Mobile and forwarded numbers are not allowed. Domestic call rates must apply—international call rates are prohibited.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Indonesia (ID)</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>(1) Your website must have a fully localized Bahasa Indonesia version.</li>
<li>(2) Prices must be displayed in IDR (Indonesian Rupiah).</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>

<p>If your company is registered in the US, you must provide the information for at least one U.S. individual associated with your company to enable card payments. If you haven't submitted this information yet, we'll reach out to help you complete it.</p>
<p>This individual can be a UBO (Ultimate Beneficial Owner), controlling person, or authorized representative, where</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO)</strong>: Owns 25% or more of the business, directly or indirectly.</li>
<li><strong>Controlling person</strong>: A key individual responsible for managing the business, such as a CEO or senior executive.</li>
<li><strong>Authorized representative</strong>: Has authority to act on behalf of the company.</li>
</ul>
<p>Acceptable options for a US individual:</p>
<ul>
<li>An individual who possesses a valid U.S. phone number <strong>and</strong> has a country of residence matching their ID issuing country.</li>
